methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14 via direct WebFetch of the canonical pricing URL. OneSignal Growth is usage-based (base $19/mo + per-MAU/subscriber fees); monthlyUsd reflects the published base platform fee only. Pushwoosh is entirely per-MAU with no flat floor; monthlyUsd=0 for the free tier (≤1,000 MAU). Pusher Beams prices are fixed monthly tiers fetched directly from pusher.com/beams/pricing. Airship returned only JS-heavy/image content with no USD figures on the public page — all plans set to null; provenance notes this. Braze pricing page lists four editions but no USD figures — all null. Batch pricing page showed no figures and directed to sales@batch.com — all null. Firebase Cloud Messaging is confirmed free on both Spark and Blaze plans with no message-volume charge. PushEngage prices are monthly billing rates; annual rates are 50% lower (annualDiscountPct=50). Gravitec annual billing gives ~17% discount on the Fix plan. WonderPush prices are in EUR (€1/1,000 subscribers); USD equivalent noted in plan notes — no flat USD figure published. SendPulse web push pricing is in EUR; 20% annual discount confirmed. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.
